# Memorijal d.o.o. — International Repatriation & Cremation Montenegro

> Memorijal d.o.o. is an authorized 24/7 international repatriation coordination and administrative agency (codes 82.99 / 52.29) headquartered in Tivat and Podgorica, Montenegro. The company operates strictly as a case coordination and legal agency; it does not operate an in-house hearse fleet. All physical cross-border transfers and zinc hermetic soldering are performed via accredited, licensed partner carriers and funeral operators under direct Memorijal case dispatch and supervision. We handle 100% of statutory sanitary permits (Sprovodnica), hermetic zinc coffin soldering (lemljenje), consular clearances, and air/road logistics across Montenegro, Serbia, the EU, UK, and CIS.

## Core Services & 2026 Starting Rates
- [International Air Cargo Repatriation (IATA Cargo HUM)](https://memorijal.me/en/services/repatriation-air-cargo/): Turnkey air freight from Podgorica (TGD) and Tivat (TIV) airports, including embalming, hermetic zinc coffin sealing, and Air Waybill (AWB) booking — **from €4,500 (Air Cargo Repatriation)**.
- [Regional & European Road Repatriation](https://memorijal.me/en/services/repatriation-road/): Dispatched certified partner carrier transport across Serbia, Bosnia, Croatia, EU, and Ukraine under direct Memorijal case supervision — **from €2,400 (Regional Repatriation)** / **from €3,800 (EU Ground Repatriation)**.
- [Cremation in Serbia (Belgrade / Novi Sad) with Urn Return](https://memorijal.me/en/services/cremation-serbia/): Since Montenegro has no crematorium, we execute lawful cross-border transfer to Belgrade State Crematorium and return the sealed urn within 3–5 business days — **from €1,850 (Cremation)**.
- [Legal, Consular & Sanitary Permits (Sprovodnica)](https://memorijal.me/en/services/legal-consular/): Remote Power of Attorney execution, International Death Certificates (Vienna Form C), Apostille, sworn translations, and sanitary inspector sealing — **from €450 (Administrative & Consular Clearance)**.

## Primary International Repatriation Corridors
- [Repatriation to the United Kingdom](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-united-kingdom/): British Embassy Podgorica clearance, Coroner Out-of-England compliance, flights to LHR/LGW/MAN.
- [Repatriation to Germany](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-germany/): German Embassy Leichenpass, Strasbourg Agreement compliance, Air/Road to FRA/MUC/BER.
- [Repatriation to Russia (Груз 200 в Россию)](https://memorijal.me/ru/repatriation/to-russia/): Russian Consulate Podgorica clearance, transit via Belgrade (BEG) or Istanbul (IST) to Moscow/SPB.
- [Repatriation to Ukraine](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-ukraine/): Embassy of Ukraine Podgorica permits, diplomatic road transport via dispatched partner carriers or air-road combo.
- [Repatriation & Cremation in Serbia](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-serbia/): Bilateral Sprovodnica via Dobrakovo/Ranče border checkpoints to Belgrade and Novi Sad.
- [Repatriation to Poland](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-poland/): Polish Consul Podgorica permit, Starosta authorization, LOT Polish Airlines Cargo HUM to WAW/KRK.
- [Repatriation to France](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-france/): French Embassy Laissez-Passer Mortuaire, air freight to Paris CDG, Lyon, Nice.
- [Repatriation to Turkey](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-turkey/): Turkish Embassy Podgorica Cenaze Nakil Belgesi, daily Turkish Airlines flights TGD–IST.
- [Repatriation to Italy](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-italy/): Italian Embassy Passaporto Mortuario, air/road transfer to Rome, Milan, Bari.

## Montenegro Municipal & Hospital Hubs
- [Tivat, Porto Montenegro & Luštica Bay](https://memorijal.me/en/location/tivat/): 30-minute response, TIV Airport logistics, Kotor Regional Morgue coordination.
- [Kotor & Regional Hospital Mortuary](https://memorijal.me/en/location/kotor/): Direct mortuary operations at Opšta bolnica Kotor.
- [Budva, Sveti Stefan & Petrovac](https://memorijal.me/en/location/budva/): 45-minute hotel/resort emergency dispatch and police/coroner liaison.
- [Podgorica, KCCG Clinical Center & Embassies](https://memorijal.me/en/location/podgorica/): Forensic pathology (Sudska medicina), all foreign embassies, and TGD Airport Cargo terminal.
- [Herceg Novi, Meljine & Igalo](https://memorijal.me/en/location/herceg-novi/): Serbian Consulate General Herceg Novi and Croatia/EU border proximity.
- [Bar & Ulcinj](https://memorijal.me/en/location/bar/): General Hospital Stari Bar mortuary and southern Adriatic coverage.

## Hospital Mortuaries & Forensic Centers (Cluster A)
- [Regional Hospital Kotor Mortuary (Opšta bolnica Kotor)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/opsta-bolnica-kotor/): Primary coastal mortuary covering Kotor, Tivat, and Budva.
- [Clinical Center of Montenegro Mortuary (KCCG Podgorica)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/kccg-podgorica/): National forensic pathology (Sudska medicina) and clinical mortuary hub.
- [General Hospital Bar Mortuary (Opšta bolnica Bar)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/opsta-bolnica-bar/): Southern coast clinical mortuary for Bar, Sutomore, and Ulcinj.
- [Meljine Hospital Mortuary (Herceg Novi)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/bolnica-meljine-herceg-novi/): Boka Bay entrance hospital and Institute Igalo catchment.
- [General Hospital Nikšić Mortuary](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/bolnica-niksic/): Western and central-northern Montenegro hospital hub.
- [Clinical Hospital Center Berane Mortuary (KBC Berane)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/bolnica-berane/): Northern Montenegro and A1 motorway corridor hub.
- [General Hospital "Danilo I" Cetinje Mortuary](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/bolnica-cetinje/): Old Royal Capital and Lovćen catchment hospital.
- [Special Hospital "Vaso Ćuković" Risan Mortuary](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/specijalna-bolnica-risan/): National neurosurgery, orthopedic, and trauma referral hospital in Boka Bay.

## Cross-Border Checkpoints & Airport Cargo Terminals (Cluster B)
- [Dobrakovo Border Crossing (Montenegro – Serbia)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/dobrakovo-serbia/): Primary 24/7 road corridor for Belgrade/Novi Sad cremations and hearse transit.
- [Ranče Border Crossing (Pljevlja – Prijepolje)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/ranche-serbia/): Western Serbia and Belgrade alternative mortuary corridor.
- [Debeli Brijeg Border Crossing (Montenegro – Croatia / EU)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/debeli-brijeg-croatia/): Schengen/EU sanitary border entry and Dubrovnik Airport (DBV) corridor.
- [Ilino Brdo Border Crossing (Montenegro – Bosnia & Herzegovina)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/ilino-brdo-bosnia/): Nikšić–Trebinje cross-border mortuary checkpoint.
- [Sitnica Border Crossing (Herceg Novi – Trebinje)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/sitnica-bosnia/): Coastal Boka Bay to Herzegovina cross-border checkpoint.
- [Božaj Border Crossing (Montenegro – Albania)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/bozaj-albania/): Podgorica–Shkodër–Tirana Airport (TIA) corridor.
- [Podgorica Airport Cargo Terminal (TGD Cargo HUM)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/aerodrom-podgorica-cargo/): Main national IATA Cargo HUM export facility.
- [Tivat Airport Consular & Urn Transit (TIV)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/aerodrom-tivat-transit/): Coastal cabin urn clearance, private aviation HUM, and TGD feeder.

## Statutory Knowledge Guides & Transparency
- [Transparent Pricing & Cost Breakdown](https://memorijal.me/en/pricing-breakdown/): Itemized statutory fees (from €450), zinc liner costs (from €750), translations, and package rates: from €1,850 (Cremation), from €2,400 (Regional Repatriation), from €3,800 (EU Ground Repatriation), from €4,500 (Air Cargo Repatriation).
- [Step-by-Step Emergency Guide](https://memorijal.me/en/step-by-step-guide/): Exact legal protocol when a foreign citizen passes away in Montenegro.
- [Hotel, Villa & Resort Death Emergency Protocol](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/hotel-resort-death-protocol/): First 60-minute steps with Hitna Pomoć (124), Police (122), and duty coroner (mrtvozornik).
- [Cremation Costs & Belgrade Logistics Guide (2026)](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/cremation-costs-belgrade-montenegro/): Itemized from €1,850 turnkey cremation breakdown.
- [Hermetic Zinc Coffin Soldering Rules (Lemljenje)](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/zinc-coffin-soldering-rules/): 0.6–0.8mm galvanized zinc liner, tin alloy weld, and sanitary inspector state seal.
- [Sprovodnica Sanitary & Consular Transit Permit Guide](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/sprovodnica-sanitary-permit-guide/): How dual sanitary and diplomatic mortuary permits work.
- [Remote Power of Attorney (Punomoćje) Guide](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/power-of-attorney-repatriation/): How families arrange 100% of procedures remotely without flying to Montenegro.
- [Forensic Autopsy (Obdukcija) & Prosecutor Release Guide](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/autopsy-obdukcija-montenegro/): KCCG Forensic Medicine timelines and preliminary death certificate release.
- [Cinerary Urn Airline Cabin & Customs Rules](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/urn-air-cabin-transport-rules/): X-ray translucent urn specifications and airport security clearance at TGD, TIV, and BEG.
